ChatSession.title: ChatSession
ChatSession.description: Represents a conversational thread created by a user.

id.description: The unique identifier of the chat session.

title.description: The title or topic of the conversation.

userId.description: The ID of the user who owns this session.

Message.title: Message
Message.description: An individual message within a ChatSession conversation.

id.description: The unique identifier of the message.

role.description: The author of the message: either the user or the model.

content.description: The text content of the message.

modelUsed.description: The model that generated the response, populated only when role is 'model'.

Personalization.title: Personalization
Personalization.description: User-specific settings indicating preferred AI tone and custom instructions.

aiTone.description: The selected AI tone of voice.

customPersonality.description: Custom personality instructions given to the AI.

userProfile.description: A brief summary of what the AI should know about the user.

UsageLog.title: UsageLog
UsageLog.description: Log entry for rate limiting tracking (Thinking and MAX modes).

/sessions/{sessionId}.description: List of active chat sessions created by authentication users.

/sessions/{sessionId}/messages/{messageI.description: Historically ordered message entries belonging to a specific chat session.

/users/{userId}/settings/{settingId}.description: Individually customized personalization settings for the user.

/users/{userId}/usage_logs/{logId}.description: Rate limit usage logs for specific high-compute modes.
